register_class_properties: decorate a class with register_class_properties to enable tunable property registration for all its properties
register_property: decorate a property getter or setter with register_property to expose it as a dynamically tunable property
register_dynamic_object: call register_dynamic_object in an object init to register it in the global dynamic objects registry
overrides: use the overrides decorator to annotate a method that overrides a parent class method and validate it exists
DynamicObjects_get_objects: create a DynamicObjects container and call get_objects to retrieve all live weak-referenced objects currently registered
